convention.scale_factor: a = 1 at the end of inflation / instant radiation release; H(a) = H_i/a^2 for constant g*
convention.numbers: comoving number a^3 n / H_i^3 (dimensionless), one bosonic degree per species; X and Xbar separate
convention.momentum: q = a p, tabulated as q/H_i; physical p = q H_i/a; p/m_X at a is (q/H_i) H_i/(a m_X)
convention.energy: conformal energy a E in units of H_i; R = conformal energy / E_X with E_X = a^4 rho_X/H_i^4 of the released condensate
convention.phase_space: n = int dp p^2 f/(2 pi^2) per degree; comoving f(q) = 2 pi^2 (dN/dln q)/q^3
convention.codex_9877518: identical to Codex DECAY_SOURCE.json (dN_each_over_H3_dlnq, q_over_H, a_end = 1); the translations below map to the review tracks

background.note: g* is constant through every vector decay (T_vis > 9 TeV); at the case-L coordinate (T_vis = 46 GeV) H is 3-4% above H_i/a^2; the comoving source tables do not depend on it

R4_fragmentation_template.source: tracks/spectrum (own, certified): prepared spherical Gaussian, Q0=38969.39, E0/Q0=0.99954 m_X; X bins F4long R=480 T=48000, Xbar bins F3h R=240 T=12000 rescaled to the converged N_Xbar
R4_fragmentation_template.s_quanta: N_s = 7.8 scaled, <omega> = 3.24 m_X (p ~ 2.1 m_X); each can decay s -> X Xbar (vacuum width 1.73e-5 GeV)
R4_fragmentation_template.assumption: [A] the heavy-point release fragments like a charge-saturated object; it does not: eps_q = 0.146 means ~ (1+2j) quanta per net charge and 5.95 m_X of energy per net charge, against 1.0 m_X in the template. Use only as a spectral shape alternative.
